word_count_mismatch_threshold_pct.provenance: chosen by the operator, 2026-10-10: a chapter whose output word count differs from the PDF-extracted word count by more than this percentage is flagged as a candidate for the --vlm-check second opinion; not measured against a corpus

math_density_min_symbols_per_line.provenance: chosen by the operator, 2026-10-10: a non-delimited line is counted as a rough equation match when it contains at least this many math-symbol characters; not measured against a corpus -- the whole equations_rough metric is a rough heuristic by design (no formula-aware backend is installed), stated as such in every report this script produces

math_symbol_chars.provenance: a fixed character set (ASCII operators + common Greek letters + math operator Unicode block), not a measurement -- data for the equations_rough heuristic, R6

vlm_check_timeout_s.provenance: chosen by the operator, 2026-10-10: a vision-capable local model reading rendered page images is slower than a text-only call; R10 requires an explicit bound

vlm_check_dpi.provenance: chosen by the operator, 2026-10-10: PyMuPDF page-render resolution for the --vlm-check second opinion, matching mineru's own typical rendering DPI for VLM input

vlm_check_base_url.provenance: Ollama's own documented default local API address; not machine-specific (R1 -- overridable per call, never required to be this value)
